rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an intense light that hurts the eyes.

example.english: At noon, the glass reflected glare that made my eyes hurt.
example.traditional: 正午嗰陣，玻璃反射出刺眼嘅光，搞到我眼都痛。

rows.note: Use this for someone’s angry or fierce look at another person.

example.english: When they heard I was quitting, they gave me a glare.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到我辭職，就用惡狠狠嘅眼神望住我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 ngo5 ci4 zik1 zau6 jung6 ok3 han2 han2 ge3 ngaan5 san4 mong6 zyu6 ngo5
